fullName: High Absorption Magnesium Powder Sweet Peach

dailyValueTargetGroup.name: Adults and children 4 or more years of age

statements.notes:
Doctor’s Best High Absorption Magnesium Powder in Sweet Peach flavor. This superior formula with 100% chelated lysinate glycinate, absorbs effectively to support muscle relaxation and optimum nerve function without the gastrointestinal distress.
Made with natural sweetener and peach flavor

Muscle relaxation and restful sleep
Essential in 300 enzyme systems that support biochemical functions
Up to 6x better absorbed than other forms of magnesium

Made with a patented, organic form of bioavailable magnesium that is 100% chelated
Contains magnesium chelated with amino acids, L-Lysine and L-Glycine, providing high absorption
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Note: Some settling of contents may occur, which may cause slight variations in number of servings. Product is sold by weight not volume.
Store in a cool dry place.
The Albion Gold Medallion design is a registered trademark of Albion Laboratories, Inc.

Suggested Adult Use: We recommend starting with 1 scoop (~4 grams) with 6-8 oz of water and gradually increasing to 2 scoops (~8 grams) with 12-16 oz of water daily, or as recommended by a nutritionally informed physician.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: If you are pregnant, lactating, have kidney problems or other existing medical condition, consult a physician for magnesium dosing recommendation and possible adverse interactions with any medications you are currently taking.
